messages:
jess: Quick heads-up — planning a small-window base-image rebuild next Tue 03:00 UTC. Need to coordinate three things: (1) RBAC changes for the signing service account, (2) confirm audit-log export to Splunk for KMS/iam events, and (3) KMS key propagation to staging. Who can take owning pieces?

sam: I can own RBAC. can you paste the exact perms you expect? also what’s the canary plan?

jess: TL;DR: cosign signer should only get narrow KMS signing + service account usage. Draft role below (please nit):

```
# minimal role for cosign signer
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: cosign-signer
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
# Cloud IAM binding (conceptual):
# roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter -> too broad
# prefer: roles/cloudkms.publicKeySign? (custom role: AsymmetricSign only)
```

maria: Build infra notes: cosign is configured to use a KMS key at
projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/image-signing/cryptoKeys/cosign
That key is not replicated into the staging keyring today — we should either replicate or create a staging key and rotate the signer URI at runtime.

henry: For audit logging: ensure Cloud Audit Logs (DATA_ACCESS / ADMIN_ACTIVITY) are exported to our pubsub -> splunk-forwarder topic. We should smoke-test by emitting a synthetic sign event in staging. Example test call to exercise log pipeline: 

```
# quick test: create a fake sign and check logs
curl -X POST https://staging-builds.internal/api/v1/sign -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" -d '{"image":"gcr.io/staging/app:canary"}'
# then grep for KMS access in the logs sink
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=\"k8s_container\" AND protoPayload.methodName: \"AsymmetricSign\"' --limit 5
```

sam: RBAC tweak suggestion: bind the custom KMS role only to the serviceAccount:build-cosign@staging.svc.cluster.local and add a condition limiting resource name to the exact key path. That avoids broad access if SA creds leak. Snippet: `member: serviceAccount:staging.build.svc.id.goog[build/cosign]` with condition `resource.name==projects/redwood-prod/.../cryptoKeys/cosign`.

jess: Good. Also we need an incident fallback: if signing fails mid-cutover, stop the pipeline, revert to previous signed image tag and open an incident channel. @henry can you add a short runbook entry for that?

henry: Yep. Will add runbook steps: 1) pause release, 2) check KMS 403s, 3) validate SA binding in IAM, 4) if key replication missing then switch to backup key and mark rollback. Also will add the specific log queries for Splunk.

maria: On CI side I'll add an integration test that: (a) attempts to sign a tiny test manifest in staging, (b) verifies signature with cosign verify, (c) asserts the signing event appears in the audit sink within 2m. I'll open a PR with the test and a small helper to set KEY_URI at runtime.

jess: Timeline proposal: sam opens RBAC PR today -> review/merge -> replicate key or create staging key -> maria runs signing test -> henry validates audit export -> small rebuild -> canary deploy. Can we aim for a dry-run Mon?

sam: :thumbsup: Opening RBAC PR now, will add the terraform snippet restricting the binding and the IAM condition.

```
resource "google_service_account_iam_binding" "cosign_signer" {
  service_account_id = google_service_account.cosign.email
  role               = "roles/cloudkms.signer"
  members            = ["serviceAccount:staging.build.svc.id.goog[build/cosign]"]
  condition {
    title       = "limit-key"
    expression  = "resource.name == \"projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/image-signing/cryptoKeys/cosign\""
  }
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR #4123 created by sam: "rbac: restrict cosign signer to staging SA + key condition"

jess: Nice. Final ask: make sure KMS IAM access logs are searchable in Splunk so we can timestamp who/what used the key during the cutover. If anyone sees unexpected 403s, alert on-call and annotate runbook.

henry: Will add the Splunk query and the quick triage checklist: check SA binding, key replication status, and service account token expiry. I'll also add the exact grep query for gcloud logging into the runbook.

jess: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread and ping me when PR+test exist.

sam: will do, will ping after merge.

maria: PR for the integration test incoming in ~30m.

henry: runbook entry added (draft) — linking when PRs are up.
